title: Designer: design QA pass on built pages
when: Pages are built and the designer checks that the result matches the spec and looks right at phone and desktop widths.
prompt:
Goal: A list of visual defects with exact CSS fixes, applied as small patches, so the page matches the intended design.
Steps:
1. Open the page with preview at 375 px and at a desktop width; note anything that overflows, overlaps or wraps badly.
2. Compare against the spec: colors, font sizes, spacing scale, radius, button styles; flag any value not in the scale.
3. Check rhythm: equal gaps between sections, aligned left edges, consistent card heights in a row.
4. Check states: hover and focus-visible on links and buttons, error styles on fields.
5. Check long content: long names, three line titles, an empty list message.
6. Fix each defect with an edit_file patch in the stylesheet, one selector at a time.
Quality bar:
- Every fix uses an existing token or scale value.
- Nothing scrolls sideways at 375 px.
- Focus is visible on every control.
Pitfalls:
- Adding new one off values to fix one spot.
- Fixing with !important.
- Checking only the desktop width.
Verify:
- [ ] Both widths checked.
- [ ] Off scale values replaced.
- [ ] States present.
- [ ] Braces balanced after patches.
Output: Patched style.css and a note listing each defect and its fix.

examples.input: revisa o visual da pagina de precos
examples.output: cards misaligned at 768px: grid align-items stretch; button padding 13px to var(--space-3)
